dialect-with-space.json.why: dialect flags are comma-separated without spaces

dtype-not-storage.json.why: storage dtypes are F32, F64 and I32 only

enum-without-table.json.why: an Enum channel names its enumeration table

marker-unknown-class.json.why: unknown companion classes stay opaque, never markers

missing-warnings.json.why: warnings is required (empty when nothing was logged)

no-layers.json.why: every source has at least the Normal layer

null-vendor-id.json.why: absent optionals are omitted, never null

rate-zero.json.why: a uniform rate has num >= 1 (zero-rate channels are skipped)

timing-both-forms.json.why: timing is a rate or timestamped, not both
